balances = Hash(default_value=0)
approvals = Hash(default_value=0)
metadata = Hash()
GOVERNANCE_CONTRACT = 'governance'
TransferEvent = LogEvent('Transfer', {'from': indexed(str), 'to': indexed(str), 'amount': (int, decimal)})
ApproveEvent = LogEvent('Approve', {'from': indexed(str), 'to': indexed(str), 'amount': (int, decimal)})

def canonical_genesis_amount(value: Any):
    assert not isinstance(value, bool), 'Genesis balance must not be boolean.'
    amount = decimal(str(value))
    assert amount >= 0, 'Genesis balance cannot be negative.'
    return amount

def require_genesis_account(account: str):
    assert isinstance(account, str) and account != '', 'Genesis account must be non-empty.'
    return validate_account(account)

def require_canonical_hex_account(account: str):
    if len(account) != 64 or account == account.lower():
        return
    for character in account:
        if character not in '0123456789abcdefABCDEF':
            return
    assert False, 'Hex account must be a canonical lowercase 64-hex key.'

@export
def validate_account(account: str):
    assert account != '', 'Account must be non-empty.'
    assert len(account.encode('utf-8')) <= 511 - len('currency.balances:'), 'Account exceeds the storage key limit.'
    require_canonical_hex_account(account)
    return account

def seed_default_balances(vk: str):
    balances[vk] = 5555555.55
    balances['team_lock'] = 16666666.65
    balances['dao'] = 33333333.3
    balances['team_lock'] += 49999999.95
    balances[vk] += 5555555.55
    return balances[vk] + balances['team_lock'] + balances['dao']

def seed_configured_balances(initial_balances: dict):
    assert initial_balances is not None, 'initial_balances is required.'
    assert len(initial_balances) > 0, 'initial_balances must not be empty.'
    total_supply = decimal('0')
    for account in initial_balances:
        account = require_genesis_account(account)
        amount = canonical_genesis_amount(initial_balances[account])
        balances[account] = amount
        total_supply += amount
    assert total_supply > 0, 'Genesis total supply must be positive.'
    return total_supply

def seed_token_metadata(token_metadata: dict=None):
    metadata['token_name'] = 'XIAN'
    metadata['token_symbol'] = 'XIAN'
    metadata['token_logo_url'] = 'https://xian.org/assets/img/logo.svg'
    metadata['token_logo_svg'] = ''
    metadata['token_website'] = 'https://xian.org'
    metadata['operator'] = 'team_lock'
    metadata['permit_authorizer'] = 'permit_authorizer'
    if token_metadata is None:
        return
    for key in token_metadata:
        assert key != 'total_supply', 'total_supply is managed by the contract.'
        assert key != 'operator', 'operator is managed by governance.'
        assert key != 'permit_authorizer', 'permit_authorizer is managed by governance.'
        metadata[key] = token_metadata[key]

@construct
def seed(vk: str, initial_balances: dict=None, token_metadata: dict=None):
    if initial_balances is None:
        total_supply = seed_default_balances(vk)
    else:
        total_supply = seed_configured_balances(initial_balances)
    seed_token_metadata(token_metadata)
    metadata['total_supply'] = total_supply

@export
def change_metadata(key: str, value: Any):
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['operator'], 'Only operator can set metadata.'
    assert key != 'total_supply', 'total_supply is managed by the contract.'
    assert key != 'operator', 'operator is managed by governance.'
    assert key != 'permit_authorizer', 'permit_authorizer is managed by governance.'
    metadata[key] = value

def require_governance():
    assert ctx.caller == GOVERNANCE_CONTRACT, 'Only governance can change sensitive currency settings.'

def require_name(name: str, label: str):
    assert isinstance(name, str) and name != '', label + ' must be non-empty.'
    return name

def require_contract_name(name: str, label: str):
    name = require_name(name, label)
    assert importlib.exists(name), label + ' contract does not exist.'
    return name

@export
def set_operator(new_operator: str):
    require_governance()
    metadata['operator'] = require_name(new_operator, 'new_operator')
    return metadata['operator']

@export
def set_permit_authorizer(new_authorizer: str):
    require_governance()
    metadata['permit_authorizer'] = require_contract_name(new_authorizer, 'new_authorizer')
    return metadata['permit_authorizer']

@export
def transfer(amount: decimal, to: str):
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances.'
    validate_account(to)
    assert balances[ctx.caller] >= amount, 'Not enough coins to send.'
    balances[ctx.caller] -= amount
    balances[to] += amount
    TransferEvent({'from': ctx.caller, 'to': to, 'amount': amount})

@export
def approve(amount: decimal, to: str):
    assert amount >= 0, 'Cannot approve negative balances.'
    approvals[ctx.caller, to] = amount
    ApproveEvent({'from': ctx.caller, 'to': to, 'amount': amount})

@export
def approve_from_authorizer(owner: str, spender: str, amount: decimal):
    authorizer = metadata['permit_authorizer'] or 'permit_authorizer'
    assert ctx.caller == authorizer, 'Only permit authorizer can approve on behalf of others.'
    assert amount >= 0, 'Cannot approve negative balances.'
    approvals[owner, spender] = amount
    ApproveEvent({'from': owner, 'to': spender, 'amount': amount})

@export
def transfer_from(amount: decimal, to: str, main_account: str):
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances.'
    validate_account(to)
    assert approvals[main_account, ctx.caller] >= amount, f'Not enough coins approved to send. You have {approvals[main_account, ctx.caller]} approved and are trying to spend {amount}'
    assert balances[main_account] >= amount, 'Not enough coins to send.'
    approvals[main_account, ctx.caller] -= amount
    balances[main_account] -= amount
    balances[to] += amount
    TransferEvent({'from': main_account, 'to': to, 'amount': amount})

@export
def balance_of(address: str):
    return balances[address]

CONTROL_CONTRACT = 'validators'

def require_control_contract():
    assert ctx.caller == CONTROL_CONTRACT, 'Only validators can transfer DAO funds.'

@export
def transfer_from_dao(args: dict):
    require_control_contract()
    contract_name = args.get('contract_name')
    amount = args.get('amount')
    to = args.get('to')
    assert contract_name is not None, 'Contract name is required'
    assert amount > 0, 'Amount must be greater than 0'
    assert to is not None, 'To is required'
    contract = importlib.import_module(contract_name)
    contract.transfer(amount=amount, to=to)

permits = Hash()
nonces = Hash(default_value=0)
NEWLINE = chr(10)
TOKEN_PERMIT_INTERFACE = [importlib.Func('approve_from_authorizer', args=('owner', 'spender', 'amount'))]

@construct
def seed():
    pass

def parse_time(value: str):
    return datetime.datetime.strptime(value, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

def require_text(value: str, label: str):
    assert isinstance(value, str) and value != '', label + ' is required.'
    return value

def canonical_amount(value: Any):
    assert not isinstance(value, bool), 'Permit amount must not be boolean.'
    amount = decimal(str(value))
    assert amount >= 0, 'Cannot approve negative balances.'
    return amount

def require_token(token_contract: str):
    assert importlib.exists(token_contract), 'Token contract does not exist.'
    assert importlib.enforce_interface(token_contract, TOKEN_PERMIT_INTERFACE), 'Token contract does not satisfy the permit authorizer interface.'
    return importlib.import_module(token_contract)

@export
def permit(token_contract: str, owner: str, spender: str, value: Any, deadline: str, nonce: int, signature: str):
    token_contract = require_text(token_contract, 'token_contract')
    owner = require_text(owner, 'owner')
    spender = require_text(spender, 'spender')
    deadline = require_text(deadline, 'deadline')
    assert isinstance(nonce, int), 'nonce must be an integer.'
    assert nonce >= 0, 'nonce must be non-negative.'
    deadline_time = parse_time(deadline)
    amount = canonical_amount(value)
    current_nonce = nonces[owner]
    assert nonce == current_nonce, 'Invalid permit nonce.'
    permit_msg = construct_permit_msg(token_contract=token_contract, owner=owner, spender=spender, amount=amount, deadline=str(deadline_time), nonce=nonce)
    permit_hash = hashlib.sha3_text(permit_msg)
    assert permits[permit_hash] is None, 'Permit can only be used once.'
    assert now < deadline_time, 'Permit has expired.'
    assert crypto.verify(owner, permit_msg, signature), 'Invalid signature.'
    token = require_token(token_contract)
    nonces[owner] = current_nonce + 1
    permits[permit_hash] = True
    token.approve_from_authorizer(owner=owner, spender=spender, amount=amount)
    return permit_hash

def construct_permit_msg(token_contract: str, owner: str, spender: str, amount: Any, deadline: str, nonce: int):
    return 'xian-permit-v2' + NEWLINE + 'chain_id:' + chain_id + NEWLINE + 'authorizer:' + ctx.this + NEWLINE + 'token_contract:' + token_contract + NEWLINE + 'owner:' + owner + NEWLINE + 'spender:' + spender + NEWLINE + 'amount:' + str(amount) + NEWLINE + 'deadline:' + deadline + NEWLINE + 'nonce:' + str(nonce)

ApproveEvent = LogEvent('Approve', {'from': indexed(str), 'to': indexed(str), 'amount': (int, decimal)})

def require_canonical_hex_account(account: str):
    if len(account) != 64 or account == account.lower():
        return
    for character in account:
        if character not in '0123456789abcdefABCDEF':
            return
    assert False, 'Hex account must be a canonical lowercase 64-hex key.'

@construct
def seed(token_name: str, token_symbol: str, token_logo_url: str, token_logo_svg: str, token_website: str, initial_supply: Any, initial_holder: str, operator_address: str):
    assert isinstance(token_name, str) and token_name != '', 'token_name must be non-empty.'
    assert isinstance(token_symbol, str) and token_symbol != '', 'token_symbol must be non-empty.'
    assert isinstance(token_logo_url, str), 'token_logo_url must be a string.'
    assert isinstance(token_logo_svg, str), 'token_logo_svg must be a string.'
    assert isinstance(token_website, str), 'token_website must be a string.'
    assert isinstance(initial_supply, (int, decimal)), 'initial_supply must be numeric.'
    assert initial_supply >= 0, 'initial_supply must be non-negative.'
    assert isinstance(initial_holder, str) and initial_holder != '', 'initial_holder must be non-empty.'
    assert isinstance(operator_address, str) and operator_address != '', 'operator_address must be non-empty.'
    require_canonical_hex_account(initial_holder)
    require_canonical_hex_account(operator_address)
    balances[initial_holder] = initial_supply
    metadata['token_name'] = token_name
    metadata['token_symbol'] = token_symbol
    metadata['token_logo_url'] = token_logo_url
    metadata['token_logo_svg'] = token_logo_svg
    metadata['token_website'] = token_website
    metadata['total_supply'] = initial_supply
    operator.set(operator_address)

@export
def change_metadata(key: str, value: Any):
    assert ctx.caller == operator.get(), 'Only operator can set metadata!'
    metadata[key] = value

@export
def change_operator(new_operator: str):
    assert ctx.caller == operator.get(), 'Only operator can change operator!'
    assert isinstance(new_operator, str) and new_operator != '', 'new_operator must be non-empty.'
    require_canonical_hex_account(new_operator)
    operator.set(new_operator)

@export
def operator_of():
    return operator.get()

@export
def balance_of(address: str):
    return balances[address]

@export
def transfer(amount: decimal, to: str):
    require_canonical_hex_account(to)
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'
    assert balances[ctx.caller] >= amount, 'Not enough coins to send!'
    balances[ctx.caller] -= amount
    balances[to] += amount
    TransferEvent({'from': ctx.caller, 'to': to, 'amount': amount})

@export
def approve(amount: decimal, to: str):
    require_canonical_hex_account(to)
    assert amount >= 0, 'Cannot approve negative balances!'
    approvals[ctx.caller, to] = amount
    ApproveEvent({'from': ctx.caller, 'to': to, 'amount': amount})

@export
def transfer_from(amount: decimal, to: str, main_account: str):
    require_canonical_hex_account(to)
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'
    assert approvals[main_account, ctx.caller] >= amount, f'Not enough coins approved to send! You have {approvals[main_account, ctx.caller]} and are trying to spend {amount}'
    assert balances[main_account] >= amount, 'Not enough coins to send!'
    approvals[main_account, ctx.caller] -= amount
    balances[main_account] -= amount
    balances[to] += amount
    TransferEvent({'from': main_account, 'to': to, 'amount': amount})"

def resolve_controller(address: Any, field_name: str):
    if address is None or address == '':
        return ctx.caller
    assert isinstance(address, str), field_name + ' must be a string.'
    assert address != '', field_name + ' must be non-empty.'
    return address

def build_token_source():
    return XSC001_TOKEN_SOURCE

@export
def create_token(token_contract: str, token_name: str, token_symbol: str, initial_supply: Any, token_logo_url: str='', token_logo_svg: str='', token_website: str='', initial_holder: str=None, operator_address: str=None):
    assert isinstance(token_contract, str) and token_contract != '', 'token_contract must be non-empty.'
    assert isinstance(token_name, str) and token_name != '', 'token_name must be non-empty.'
    assert isinstance(token_symbol, str) and token_symbol != '', 'token_symbol must be non-empty.'
    assert isinstance(initial_supply, (int, decimal)), 'initial_supply must be numeric.'
    assert initial_supply >= 0, 'initial_supply must be non-negative.'
    if token_logo_url is None:
        token_logo_url = ''
    if token_logo_svg is None:
        token_logo_svg = ''
    if token_website is None:
        token_website = ''
    assert isinstance(token_logo_url, str), 'token_logo_url must be a string.'
    assert isinstance(token_logo_svg, str), 'token_logo_svg must be a string.'
    assert isinstance(token_website, str), 'token_website must be a string.'
    resolved_initial_holder = resolve_controller(initial_holder, 'initial_holder')
    resolved_operator = resolve_controller(operator_address, 'operator_address')
    submission.submit_contract(name=token_contract, code=build_token_source(), owner=None, constructor_args={'token_name': token_name, 'token_symbol': token_symbol, 'token_logo_url': token_logo_url, 'token_logo_svg': token_logo_svg, 'token_website': token_website, 'initial_supply': initial_supply, 'initial_holder': resolved_initial_holder, 'operator_address': resolved_operator})
    submission.change_developer(contract=token_contract, new_developer=ctx.caller)
    TokenCreatedEvent({'contract': token_contract, 'creator': ctx.signer, 'initial_holder': resolved_initial_holder, 'operator': resolved_operator, 'token_symbol': token_symbol, 'initial_supply': initial_supply})
    return {'contract': token_contract, 'creator': ctx.signer, 'initial_holder': resolved_initial_holder, 'operator': resolved_operator}

@construct
def seed():
    time_anchor_counter.set(0)
    time_anchor_head.set(None)
    job_counter.set(0)

def membership():
    return importlib.import_module('validators')

def is_integer(value: Any):
    return isinstance(value, int) and (not isinstance(value, bool))

def slashable_pending_unbond(unbond: dict, height: int):
    return unbond is not None and height is not None and (unbond['claimed'] == False) and (unbond['amount'] > 0) and (height <= unbond['created_block'])

def current_block_number():
    return block_num or 0

def require_validators():
    assert ctx.caller == 'validators', 'Validators only.'

def unbond_precedes(left: int, right: int):
    left_time = unbonds[left]['unlock_at']
    right_time = unbonds[right]['unlock_at']
    if left_time is None:
        return right_time is None and left < right
    if right_time is None:
        return True
    return left_time < right_time or (left_time == right_time and left < right)

def swap_unbond_heap(validator: str, left: int, right: int):
    left_id = unbond_heap_nodes[validator, left]
    right_id = unbond_heap_nodes[validator, right]
    unbond_heap_nodes[validator, left] = right_id
    unbond_heap_nodes[validator, right] = left_id
    unbond_heap_positions[left_id] = right
    unbond_heap_positions[right_id] = left

def sift_unbond_up(validator: str, position: int):
    while position > 1:
        parent = position // 2
        if not unbond_precedes(unbond_heap_nodes[validator, position], unbond_heap_nodes[validator, parent]):
            break
        swap_unbond_heap(validator, position, parent)
        position = parent
    return position

def sift_unbond_down(validator: str, position: int):
    size = unbond_heap_sizes[validator]
    while position * 2 <= size:
        child = position * 2
        if child < size and unbond_precedes(unbond_heap_nodes[validator, child + 1], unbond_heap_nodes[validator, child]):
            child += 1
        if not unbond_precedes(unbond_heap_nodes[validator, child], unbond_heap_nodes[validator, position]):
            break
        swap_unbond_heap(validator, position, child)
        position = child

@export
def track_unbond(unbond_id: int):
    require_validators()
    assert unbond_heap_positions[unbond_id] is None, 'Unbond already indexed.'
    record = unbonds[unbond_id]
    validator = record['validator']
    position = unbond_heap_sizes[validator] + 1
    unbond_heap_sizes[validator] = position
    unbond_heap_nodes[validator, position] = unbond_id
    unbond_heap_positions[unbond_id] = position
    unbond_totals[validator] += record['amount']
    sift_unbond_up(validator, position)

@export
def release_unbond(unbond_id: int):
    require_validators()
    record = unbonds[unbond_id]
    validator = record['validator']
    assert pending_counts[validator] == 0, 'Validator penalty pending.'
    position = unbond_heap_positions[unbond_id]
    assert position is not None, 'Unbond is not indexed.'
    size = unbond_heap_sizes[validator]
    last_id = unbond_heap_nodes[validator, size]
    unbond_heap_nodes[validator, size] = None
    unbond_heap_positions[unbond_id] = None
    unbond_heap_sizes[validator] = size - 1
    unbond_totals[validator] -= record['amount']
    if position < size:
        unbond_heap_nodes[validator, position] = last_id
        unbond_heap_positions[last_id] = position
        position = sift_unbond_up(validator, position)
        sift_unbond_down(validator, position)

def rekey_unbond(unbond_id: int):
    record = unbonds[unbond_id]
    position = unbond_heap_positions[unbond_id]
    assert position is not None, 'Unbond is not indexed.'
    sift_unbond_up(record['validator'], position)

@export

    require_validators()
    validator_exit_anchors[account] = enqueue_time_anchor('exit', account)

def unbond_time_start(unbond_id: int):
    exit_id = unbond_exit_anchors[unbond_id]
    if exit_id is not None:
        return exit_anchor_times[exit_id]
    return now

def anchor_unbond_time(unbond_id: int):
    record = unbonds[unbond_id]
    start = unbond_time_start(unbond_id)
    assert start is not None, 'Exit time anchor pending.'
    unlock = start + datetime.timedelta(days=record['unbonding_period_days'])
    membership().set_unbond_unlock(unbond_id=unbond_id, unlock_at=unlock)
    rekey_unbond(unbond_id)

@export
def track_unbond_time(unbond_id: int):
    require_validators()
    record = unbonds[unbond_id]
    if view_statuses[record['validator']] in EXITED_STATUSES:
        unbond_exit_anchors[unbond_id] = validator_exit_anchors[record['validator']]
    if record['unbonding_period_days'] == 0:
        membership().set_unbond_unlock(unbond_id=unbond_id, unlock_at=now)
        rekey_unbond(unbond_id)
    elif unbond_exit_anchors[unbond_id] is not None and unbond_time_start(unbond_id) is not None:
        anchor_unbond_time(unbond_id)
    else:
        enqueue_time_anchor('unbond', unbond_id)

def process_time_anchor(job_id: int, job: dict):
    if job['kind'] == 'exit':
        exit_anchor_times[job_id] = now
    else:
        anchor_unbond_time(job['reference'])
    time_anchor_jobs[job_id] = None
    if job_id == time_anchor_counter.get():
        time_anchor_head.set(None)
    else:
        time_anchor_head.set(job_id + 1)

@export
def process_time_anchors(max_work: int=MAX_TIME_ANCHOR_WORK):
    assert ctx.caller == SYSTEM_STAKE_TIME_CALLER, 'Driver only.'
    assert is_integer(max_work) and 1 <= max_work <= MAX_TIME_ANCHOR_WORK, 'Invalid time anchor batch work.'
    processed = 0
    while processed < max_work and time_anchor_head.get() is not None:
        job_id = time_anchor_head.get()
        job = time_anchor_jobs[job_id]
        if job['height'] >= current_block_number():
            break
        process_time_anchor(job_id, job)
        processed += 1
    return {'processed': processed, 'head': time_anchor_head.get()}

def pending_cursor(job: dict):
    if job['infraction_height'] is None or unbond_totals[job['member']] <= 0:
        return None
    return unbond_heads['validator', job['member']]

def initialize_pending_slash(job: dict):
    account = job['member']
    job['self_amount'] = self_bonds[account] or 0
    job['pool_amount'] = delegated[account] or 0
    job['total_slashable_bond'] = job['self_amount'] + job['pool_amount']
    job['cursor'] = pending_cursor(job)
    job['status'] = 'collect'

def validate_penalty_request(slash_bps: int, reason: str, infraction_height: int=None):
    assert is_integer(slash_bps) and slash_bps > 0 and (slash_bps <= 10000), 'Bad slash bps.'
    assert infraction_height is None or (is_integer(infraction_height) and infraction_height >= 0), 'Bad infraction height.'
    assert reason is None or (isinstance(reason, str) and len(reason) <= 256), 'Penalty reason is too long.'

@export
def enqueue(account: str, slash_bps: int, reason: str, infraction_height: int=None):
    require_validators()
    validate_penalty_request(slash_bps, reason, infraction_height)
    job_id = job_counter.get() + 1
    job_counter.set(job_id)
    job = {'id': job_id, 'member': account, 'slash_bps': slash_bps, 'reason': reason or '', 'destination': policy_config['slash_destination'] or 'dao', 'infraction_height': infraction_height, 'requested_at': now, 'requested_block': current_block_number(), 'status': 'queued', 'next_job': None, 'cursor': None, 'processed_bond': 0, 'allocated_slash': 0, 'self_bond_slashed': 0, 'delegated_slashed': 0, 'pending_unbond_slashed': 0, 'slash_amount': None}
    if pending_counts[account] == 0:
        initialize_pending_slash(job)
    previous = pending_tail.get()
    if previous is None:
        pending_head.set(job_id)
    else:
        previous_job = jobs[previous]
        previous_job['next_job'] = job_id
        jobs[previous] = previous_job
    pending_tail.set(job_id)
    jobs[job_id] = job
    pending_counts[account] += 1
    job_count.set(job_count.get() + 1)
    return {'queued': True, 'job_id': job_id, 'status': 'pending', 'member': account, 'slash_bps': slash_bps}

def collect_pending_slash(job: dict):
    unbond_id = job['cursor']
    if unbond_id is None:
        job['status'] = 'live_stake'
        return
    unbond = unbonds[unbond_id]
    if slashable_pending_unbond(unbond, job['infraction_height']):
        job['total_slashable_bond'] += unbond['amount']
    job['cursor'] = unbond_links['validator', unbond_id, 'next']

def pending_participant_slash(job: dict, amount: decimal):
    job['processed_bond'] += amount
    target = job['processed_bond'] * (job['slash_bps'] / 10000)
    part = target - job['allocated_slash']
    job['allocated_slash'] = target
    return part
LIVE_SLASH_PHASES = {'self_bond': ['self_amount', 'self_bond_slashed'], 'delegation_pool': ['pool_amount', 'delegated_slashed']}

def apply_pending_live_part(job: dict, kind: str):
    phase = LIVE_SLASH_PHASES[kind]
    part = pending_participant_slash(job, job[phase[0]])
    membership().apply_pending_slash_part(account=job['member'], kind=kind, amount=part)
    job[phase[1]] = part

def apply_pending_live_slash(job: dict):
    apply_pending_live_part(job, 'self_bond')
    apply_pending_live_part(job, 'delegation_pool')
    job['cursor'] = pending_cursor(job)
    job['status'] = 'pending_unbonds'

def apply_pending_unbond_slash(job: dict):
    unbond_id = job['cursor']
    if unbond_id is None:
        job['status'] = 'finish'
        return
    unbond = unbonds[unbond_id]
    if slashable_pending_unbond(unbond, job['infraction_height']):
        part = pending_participant_slash(job, unbond['amount'])
        membership().apply_pending_slash_part(account=job['member'], kind='pending_unbond', amount=part, unbond_id=unbond_id)
        unbond_totals[job['member']] -= part
        job['pending_unbond_slashed'] += part
    job['cursor'] = unbond_links['validator', unbond_id, 'next']

def finish_pending_slash(job: dict):
    account = job['member']
    amount = job['total_slashable_bond'] * (job['slash_bps'] / 10000)
    assert job['processed_bond'] == job['total_slashable_bond'], 'Penalty principal changed.'
    assert job['allocated_slash'] == amount, 'Penalty allocation mismatch.'
    membership().finish_pending_slash(account=account, amount=amount, destination=job['destination'])
    job['slash_amount'] = amount
    job['status'] = 'complete'
    job['completed_at'] = now
    job['completed_block'] = current_block_number()
    pending_counts[account] -= 1
    job_count.set(job_count.get() - 1)
    pending_head.set(job['next_job'])
    if job['next_job'] is None:
        pending_tail.set(None)

def pending_slash_step(job: dict):
    status = job['status']
    if status == 'queued':
        initialize_pending_slash(job)
    elif status == 'collect':
        collect_pending_slash(job)
    elif status == 'live_stake':
        apply_pending_live_slash(job)
    elif status == 'pending_unbonds':
        apply_pending_unbond_slash(job)
    else:
        assert status == 'finish', 'Invalid penalty phase.'
        finish_pending_slash(job)

@export
def process_pending_slashes(max_work: int=MAX_SLASH_BATCH_WORK):
    assert ctx.caller == '__penalty_driver__', 'Driver only.'
    assert is_integer(max_work) and max_work > 0 and (max_work <= MAX_SLASH_BATCH_WORK), 'Invalid batch work.'
    processed = 0
    completed = 0
    while processed < max_work and pending_head.get() is not None:
        job_id = pending_head.get()
        job = jobs[job_id]
        pending_slash_step(job)
        jobs[job_id] = job
        if job['status'] == 'complete':
            completed += 1
        processed += 1
    if completed > 0:
        membership().rebalance_after_penalties()
    return {'processed': processed, 'completed': completed, 'head': pending_head.get(), 'pending_jobs': job_count.get()}

def resolve_requested_power(account: str, configured_powers: dict, fallback_power: int=DEFAULT_VALIDATOR_POWER):
    power = fallback_power
    if configured_powers is not None:
        configured_power = configured_powers.get(account)
        if configured_power is not None:
            power = configured_power
    return require_validator_power(power)

def resolve_reward_key(account: str, configured_reward_keys: dict=None):
    reward_key = account
    if configured_reward_keys is not None:
        configured_reward_key = configured_reward_keys.get(account)
        if configured_reward_key is not None:
            reward_key = configured_reward_key
    return normalize_reward_key(account, reward_key)

def normalize_reward_key(account: str, reward_key: str=None):
    if reward_key is None or reward_key == '':
        reward_key = account
    return currency.validate_account(account=reward_key)

def normalize_reason(reason: str=None):
    if reason is None:
        return ''
    return reason

def normalize_jail_reason(reason: str=None):
    return normalize_reason(reason)

def is_integer(value: Any):
    return isinstance(value, int) and isinstance(value, bool) == False

def is_canonical_validator_key(value: Any):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) != CANONICAL_KEY_LENGTH:
        return False
    for character in value:
        if character not in CANONICAL_KEY_DIGITS:
            return False
    return True

def require_canonical_validator_key(value: Any):
    assert is_canonical_validator_key(value), 'Validator key must be a canonical lowercase 64-hex key.'

def require_validator_power(power: Any):
    assert is_integer(power), 'Validator power must be an integer.'
    assert power > 0, 'Validator power <= 0'
    assert power <= MAX_VALIDATOR_POWER, 'Validator power exceeds the maximum.'
    return power

def is_number(value: Any):
    return isinstance(value, (int, decimal)) and isinstance(value, bool) == False

def validate_non_empty_string(value: Any, label: str):
    assert isinstance(value, str), label + ' must be a string.'
    assert value != '', label + ' must be non-empty.'

def validate_optional_string(value: Any, label: str):
    if value is not None:
        assert isinstance(value, str), label + ' must be a string.'

def validate_object_argument(arg: Any, allowed_keys: list, required_keys: list):
    assert isinstance(arg, dict), 'Vote argument must be an object.'
    for key in arg:
        assert key in allowed_keys, 'Unexpected vote argument field.'
    for key in required_keys:
        assert arg.get(key) is not None, 'Missing vote argument field.'

def owner_pending_unbond_ids(owner: str):
    return pending_unbond_ids('owner', owner)

def pending_unbond_ids(kind: str, account: str):
    result = []
    current = pending_unbond_heads[kind, account]
    while current is not None:
        result.append(current)
        current = pending_unbond_links[kind, current, 'next']
    return result

def append_pending_unbond(kind: str, account: str, unbond_id: int):
    previous = pending_unbond_tails[kind, account]
    pending_unbond_links[kind, unbond_id, 'previous'] = previous
    if previous is None:
        pending_unbond_heads[kind, account] = unbond_id
    else:
        pending_unbond_links[kind, previous, 'next'] = unbond_id
    pending_unbond_tails[kind, account] = unbond_id

def remove_pending_unbond(kind: str, account: str, unbond_id: int):
    previous = pending_unbond_links[kind, unbond_id, 'previous']
    following = pending_unbond_links[kind, unbond_id, 'next']
    if previous is None:
        pending_unbond_heads[kind, account] = following
    else:
        pending_unbond_links[kind, previous, 'next'] = following
    if following is None:
        pending_unbond_tails[kind, account] = previous
    else:
        pending_unbond_links[kind, following, 'previous'] = previous
    pending_unbond_links[kind, unbond_id, 'previous'] = None
    pending_unbond_links[kind, unbond_id, 'next'] = None

    return [registry_accounts[index] for index in range(registry_count.get())]

def without_item(items: list, item: str):
    next_items = []
    for current_item in items:
        if current_item != item:
            next_items.append(current_item)

def effective_active_power(account: str):

    if reward_key == '':

def effective_max_commission_bps():

    if max_commission is None:
        return MAX_COMMISSION_BPS
    return min(max(max_commission, 0), MAX_COMMISSION_BPS)

def effective_commission_bps(account: str):

    if configured_bps is None:
        return DEFAULT_COMMISSION_BPS
    if configured_bps < 0:
        return DEFAULT_COMMISSION_BPS
    max_commission = effective_max_commission_bps()
    if configured_bps > max_commission:
        return max_commission
    return configured_bps

POLICY_DEFAULTS = {'selection_mode': DEFAULT_SELECTION_MODE, 'max_validators': DEFAULT_MAX_VALIDATORS, 'power_mode': DEFAULT_POWER_MODE, 'rebalance_interval': DEFAULT_REBALANCE_INTERVAL, 'activation_delay_epochs': DEFAULT_ACTIVATION_DELAY_EPOCHS, 'unbonding_period_days': DEFAULT_UNBONDING_PERIOD_DAYS, 'min_self_bond': DEFAULT_MIN_SELF_BOND, 'min_total_bond': DEFAULT_MIN_TOTAL_BOND, 'max_commission_bps': MAX_COMMISSION_BPS, 'max_active_set_churn': DEFAULT_MAX_ACTIVE_SET_CHURN, 'min_bond_margin_bps': DEFAULT_MIN_BOND_MARGIN_BPS, 'manual_override_enabled': True, 'slash_destination': DEFAULT_SLASH_DESTINATION, 'duplicate_vote_slash_bps': DEFAULT_DUPLICATE_VOTE_SLASH_BPS, 'duplicate_vote_jail': True, 'light_client_attack_slash_bps': DEFAULT_LIGHT_CLIENT_ATTACK_SLASH_BPS, 'light_client_attack_jail': True, 'max_new_power_bps': DEFAULT_MAX_NEW_POWER_BPS, 'downtime_jail_blocks': DEFAULT_DOWNTIME_JAIL_BLOCKS, 'downtime_slash_bps': DEFAULT_DOWNTIME_SLASH_BPS, 'downtime_unjail_cooldown_hours': DEFAULT_DOWNTIME_UNJAIL_COOLDOWN_HOURS}
POLICY_INT_BOUNDS = {'max_validators': [1, MAX_VALIDATOR_ACCOUNTS], 'rebalance_interval': [1, None], 'activation_delay_epochs': [0, None], 'unbonding_period_days': [0, MAX_UNBONDING_PERIOD_DAYS], 'min_self_bond': [0, None], 'min_total_bond': [0, None], 'max_commission_bps': [0, MAX_COMMISSION_BPS], 'max_active_set_churn': [0, None], 'min_bond_margin_bps': [0, None], 'duplicate_vote_slash_bps': [0, 10000], 'light_client_attack_slash_bps': [0, 10000], 'max_new_power_bps': [0, 10000], 'downtime_jail_blocks': [1, None], 'downtime_slash_bps': [0, 10000], 'downtime_unjail_cooldown_hours': [0, None]}
POLICY_CHOICES = {'selection_mode': ['manual', 'auto_top_n', 'hybrid'], 'power_mode': ['equal', 'requested', 'stake_weighted']}

def policy(key: str):
    value = config[key]
    bounds = POLICY_INT_BOUNDS.get(key)
    if value is None or value == '':
        return POLICY_DEFAULTS[key]
    if bounds is not None and value < bounds[0]:
        return POLICY_DEFAULTS[key]
    return value

def validate_policy_value(key: str, value: Any):
    if key in POLICY_CHOICES:
        assert value in POLICY_CHOICES[key], 'Bad ' + key + '.'
        return
    if key == 'slash_destination':
        validate_non_empty_string(value, key)
        currency.validate_account(account=value)
        return
    bounds = POLICY_INT_BOUNDS.get(key)
    if bounds is None:
        assert isinstance(value, bool), key + ' must be boolean.'
        return
    assert is_integer(value), key + ' must be an integer.'
    assert value >= bounds[0], key + ' is below its minimum.'
    assert bounds[1] is None or value <= bounds[1], key + ' is above its maximum.'

def evidence_slash_bps(infraction_type: str):
    if infraction_type == 'DUPLICATE_VOTE':
        return policy('duplicate_vote_slash_bps')
    if infraction_type == 'LIGHT_CLIENT_ATTACK':
        return policy('light_client_attack_slash_bps')
    if infraction_type == 'DOWNTIME':
        return policy('downtime_slash_bps')
    return 0

def evidence_should_jail(infraction_type: str):
    if infraction_type == 'DOWNTIME':
        return True
    if infraction_type == 'DUPLICATE_VOTE':
        return policy('duplicate_vote_jail')
    if infraction_type == 'LIGHT_CLIENT_ATTACK':
        return policy('light_client_attack_jail')
    return False

def is_jailed(account: str):
    return jailed[account] == True

def current_block_number():
    current_height = block_num
    if current_height is None or current_height < 0:
        return 0
    return current_height

def current_selection_epoch():
    return current_block_number() // policy('rebalance_interval')

def total_bonded(account: str):
    return self_bond[account] + total_delegated[account]

def can_accept_delegation(account: str):
    if is_jailed(account):
        return False
    status = statuses[account]
    return status == STATUS_PENDING or status == STATUS_ACTIVE or status == STATUS_APPROVED

def scaled_units(value: Any):
    return int(value * DECIMAL_SCALE)

def mul_div(value: Any, numerator: Any, denominator: Any):
    units = scaled_units(value) * scaled_units(numerator) // scaled_units(denominator)
    return decimal(units) / DECIMAL_SCALE

def delegation_value(delegator: str, validator: str):
    shares = delegation_shares[delegator, validator]
    pool_shares = total_shares[validator]
    if shares == pool_shares:
        return total_delegated[validator]
    return mul_div(shares, total_delegated[validator], pool_shares)

def shares_for_amount(validator: str, amount: decimal):
    pool_shares = total_shares[validator]
    if pool_shares <= 0:
        return amount
    pool_tokens = total_delegated[validator]
    assert pool_tokens > 0, 'Delegation pool fully slashed.'
    return mul_div(amount, pool_shares, pool_tokens)

def released_stake(delegator: str, validator: str, amount: decimal, value: decimal):
    if amount == value:
        return (delegation_shares[delegator, validator], value)
    burned = mul_div(amount, total_shares[validator], total_delegated[validator])
    released = mul_div(burned, total_delegated[validator], total_shares[validator])
    assert released > 0, 'Undelegation too small.'
    return (burned, released)

def add_pool_shares(delegator: str, validator: str, shares: decimal, amount: decimal):
    current_shares = delegation_shares[delegator, validator]
    if current_shares == 0:
        delegator_counts[validator] = delegator_counts[validator] + 1
    delegation_shares[delegator, validator] = current_shares + shares
    total_shares[validator] = total_shares[validator] + shares
    total_delegated[validator] = total_delegated[validator] + amount

def remove_pool_shares(delegator: str, validator: str, shares: decimal, amount: decimal):
    remaining_shares = delegation_shares[delegator, validator] - shares
    delegation_shares[delegator, validator] = remaining_shares
    total_shares[validator] = total_shares[validator] - shares
    total_delegated[validator] = total_delegated[validator] - amount
    if remaining_shares == 0:
        delegator_counts[validator] = delegator_counts[validator] - 1

def delegation_reward_key(delegator: str, validator: str):
    return normalize_reward_key(delegator, delegator_reward_keys[delegator, validator])

def pending_delegator_reward(delegator: str, validator: str):
    shares = delegation_shares[delegator, validator]
    return max(shares * reward_per_share[validator] - reward_debt[delegator, validator], 0)

def settle_delegator_reward(delegator: str, validator: str):
    pending = pending_delegator_reward(delegator, validator)
    if pending <= 0:
        return 0
    assert reward_pool[validator] >= pending, 'Reward pool short.'
    reward_pool[validator] = reward_pool[validator] - pending
    recipient = delegation_reward_key(delegator, validator)
    currency.transfer(pending, recipient)
    DelegatorRewardClaimedEvent({'delegator': delegator, 'validator': validator, 'recipient': recipient, 'amount': pending})
    return pending

def reset_reward_debt(delegator: str, validator: str):
    reward_debt[delegator, validator] = delegation_shares[delegator, validator] * reward_per_share[validator] + REWARD_DEBT_ROUNDING

def next_unbond_id():
    unbond_id = pending_unbond_counter.get() + 1
    pending_unbond_counter.set(unbond_id)
    return unbond_id

def track_validator(account: str):
    if known_validators[account]:
        return
    address = hashlib.sha256_hex(account)[:40]
    existing = consensus_keys[address]
    assert existing is None or existing == account, 'Consensus address already registered.'
    consensus_keys[address] = account
    known_validators[account] = True
    index = registry_count.get()
    registry_accounts[index] = account
    registry_count.set(index + 1)

def create_pending_unbond(owner: str, validator: str, amount: decimal, kind: str, reason: str=None):
    require_no_pending_slash(validator)
    assert amount > 0, 'Unbond amount <= 0'
    unbonding_period_days = config['unbonding_period_days']
    if unbonding_period_days is None:
        unbonding_period_days = DEFAULT_UNBONDING_PERIOD_DAYS
    unbond_id = next_unbond_id()
    pending_unbond = {'id': unbond_id, 'owner': owner, 'validator': validator, 'amount': amount, 'kind': kind, 'created_block': current_block_number(), 'created_at': now, 'unlock_at': None, 'unbonding_period_days': unbonding_period_days, 'claimed': False}
    if reason is not None:
        pending_unbond['reason'] = reason
    pending_unbonds[unbond_id] = pending_unbond
    append_pending_unbond('owner', owner, unbond_id)
    append_pending_unbond('validator', validator, unbond_id)
    penalties = importlib.import_module('validator_penalties')
    penalties.track_unbond(unbond_id=unbond_id)
    penalties.track_unbond_time(unbond_id=unbond_id)
    return pending_unbonds[unbond_id]

def ensure_candidate(account: str):
    current_candidates = candidate_list()
    if account not in current_candidates:
        require_selection_capacity(account, all_validator_accounts())
        current_candidates.append(account)
        candidates.set(current_candidates)

def is_known_validator(account: str):
    return account in active_nodes_list() or account in candidate_list() or pending_registrations[account] == True or (statuses[account] == STATUS_APPROVED) or (statuses[account] == STATUS_PENDING) or (statuses[account] == STATUS_LEAVING)

def has_validator_history(account: str):
    return known_validators[account] == True

def sweep_validator_bonding_state(account: str, reason: str):
    current_self_bond = self_bond[account]
    if current_self_bond > 0:
        self_bond[account] = 0
        create_pending_unbond(owner=account, validator=account, amount=current_self_bond, kind='self_bond', reason=reason)

def all_validator_accounts():
    known_accounts = []
    for account in active_nodes_list():
        if account not in known_accounts:
            known_accounts.append(account)
    for account in candidate_list():
        if account not in known_accounts:
            known_accounts.append(account)
    return known_accounts

def require_selection_capacity(account: str, known_accounts: list):
    assert account in known_accounts or len(known_accounts) < MAX_VALIDATOR_ACCOUNTS, 'Validator selection pool full.'

def ready_for_selection(account: str, selection_epoch: int):
    return selection_epoch >= eligible_at_epoch[account]

def meets_min_bonds(account: str):
    return self_bond[account] >= policy('min_self_bond') and total_bonded(account) >= policy('min_total_bond')

def require_min_bonds(account: str):
    assert self_bond[account] >= policy('min_self_bond'), 'Below the minimum self bond.'
    assert total_bonded(account) >= policy('min_total_bond'), 'Below the minimum total bond.'

def can_be_selected(account: str, selection_mode: str, selection_epoch: int):
    if is_jailed(account):
        return False
    if meets_min_bonds(account) == False:
        return False
    return status_allows_selection(account, selection_mode, selection_epoch)

def status_allows_selection(account: str, selection_mode: str, selection_epoch: int):
    status = statuses[account]
    if pending_leave[account]:
        return status == STATUS_LEAVING and account in active_nodes_list()
    if status == STATUS_ACTIVE or status == STATUS_APPROVED:
        if status == STATUS_ACTIVE:
            return True
        return ready_for_selection(account, selection_epoch)
    if selection_mode == 'auto_top_n' and pending_registrations[account] == True and ready_for_selection(account, selection_epoch):
        return True
    return False

def insert_ranked_account(ranked_accounts: list, account: str):
    account_bond = total_bonded(account)
    next_ranked_accounts = []
    inserted = False
    for ranked_account in ranked_accounts:
        ranked_bond = total_bonded(ranked_account)
        if inserted == False:
            if account_bond > ranked_bond:
                next_ranked_accounts.append(account)
                inserted = True
            elif account_bond == ranked_bond and account < ranked_account:
                next_ranked_accounts.append(account)
                inserted = True
        next_ranked_accounts.append(ranked_account)
    if inserted == False:
        next_ranked_accounts.append(account)
    return next_ranked_accounts

def ranked_selection_candidates(selection_mode: str, selection_epoch: int):
    ranked_accounts = []
    for account in all_validator_accounts():
        if can_be_selected(account, selection_mode, selection_epoch):
            ranked_accounts = insert_ranked_account(ranked_accounts, account)
    return ranked_accounts

def weakest_ranked_account(accounts: list):
    weakest_account = None
    for account in accounts:
        if weakest_account is None:
            weakest_account = account
        elif total_bonded(account) < total_bonded(weakest_account):
            weakest_account = account
        elif total_bonded(account) == total_bonded(weakest_account) and account > weakest_account:
            weakest_account = account
    return weakest_account

def weakest_selected_incumbent(accounts: list, previous_active: list):
    incumbent_accounts = []
    for account in accounts:
        if account in previous_active:
            incumbent_accounts.append(account)
    return weakest_ranked_account(incumbent_accounts)

def beats_margin(challenger: str, incumbent: str):
    margin_bps = policy('min_bond_margin_bps')
    challenger_bond = total_bonded(challenger)
    incumbent_bond = total_bonded(incumbent)
    return challenger_bond * 10000 > incumbent_bond * (10000 + margin_bps)

def selected_validator_power(account: str):
    power_mode = policy('power_mode')
    if power_mode == 'requested':
        return effective_requested_power(account)
    if power_mode == 'stake_weighted':
        weighted_power = int(total_bonded(account))
        if weighted_power <= 0:
            return 1
        if weighted_power > MAX_VALIDATOR_POWER:
            return MAX_VALIDATOR_POWER
        return weighted_power
    return DEFAULT_VALIDATOR_POWER

def approve_candidate(account: str, power: int):
    assert pending_registrations[account] == True, 'Member must have pending registration.'
    assert is_jailed(account) == False, 'Jailed.'
    track_validator(account)
    pending_registrations[account] = False
    pending_leave[account] = False
    statuses[account] = STATUS_APPROVED
    left_at[account] = None
    eligible_at_epoch[account] = current_selection_epoch() + policy('activation_delay_epochs')
    ensure_candidate(account)
    requested_power[account] = power
    reward_keys[account] = effective_reward_key(account)
    return validator_record(account)

def newcomer_power_admitted():
    if admission_epoch.get() != current_selection_epoch():
        return 0
    return admitted_new_power.get()

def record_admitted_power(power: int):
    admitted = newcomer_power_admitted()
    admission_epoch.set(current_selection_epoch())
    admitted_new_power.set(admitted + power)

def within_new_power_cap(accounts: list, previous_active: list):
    total_power = 0
    new_power = newcomer_power_admitted()
    for account in accounts:
        power = selected_validator_power(account)
        total_power += power
        if account not in previous_active:
            new_power += power
    return new_power * 10000 <= policy('max_new_power_bps') * total_power

def fill_empty_seats(selected_accounts: list, ranked_accounts: list, previous_active: list, max_validators: int, churn_budget: int):
    for account in ranked_accounts:
        if churn_budget <= 0 or len(selected_accounts) >= max_validators:
            break
        if account in previous_active:
            continue
        candidate_set = insert_ranked_account(selected_accounts, account)
        if within_new_power_cap(candidate_set, previous_active) == False:
            continue
        selected_accounts = candidate_set
        churn_budget -= 1
    return (selected_accounts, churn_budget)

def replace_incumbents(selected_accounts: list, ranked_accounts: list, previous_active: list, deactivated: list, churn_budget: int):
    for challenger in ranked_accounts:
        if churn_budget <= 0:
            break
        if challenger in previous_active or challenger in selected_accounts:
            continue
        weakest_incumbent = weakest_selected_incumbent(selected_accounts, previous_active)
        if weakest_incumbent is None:
            break
        if beats_margin(challenger, weakest_incumbent) == False:
            continue
        candidate_set = insert_ranked_account(without_item(selected_accounts, weakest_incumbent), challenger)
        if within_new_power_cap(candidate_set, previous_active) == False:
            continue
        selected_accounts = candidate_set
        if weakest_incumbent not in deactivated:
            deactivated.append(weakest_incumbent)
        churn_budget -= 1
    return selected_accounts

def rebalance_validator_set(force: bool=False, require_selection: bool=True):
    selection_mode = policy('selection_mode')
    assert selection_mode != 'manual', 'Auto selection disabled.'
    selection_epoch = current_selection_epoch()
    previous_rebalance_epoch = last_rebalance_epoch.get()
    if force == False and previous_rebalance_epoch is not None:
        assert selection_epoch > previous_rebalance_epoch, 'Already rebalanced.'
    known_accounts = all_validator_accounts()
    ranked_accounts = ranked_selection_candidates(selection_mode, selection_epoch)
    selected_accounts = []
    deactivated = []
    previous_active = active_nodes_list()
    next_candidates = []
    max_validators = policy('max_validators')
    replacement_budget = policy('max_active_set_churn')
    for account in previous_active:
        if account in ranked_accounts:
            selected_accounts = insert_ranked_account(selected_accounts, account)
        else:
            deactivated.append(account)
    overflow = len(selected_accounts) - max_validators
    if overflow > 0:
        for trim_index in range(overflow):
            weakest_active = weakest_ranked_account(selected_accounts)
            selected_accounts = without_item(selected_accounts, weakest_active)
            if weakest_active not in deactivated:
                deactivated.append(weakest_active)
    selected_accounts, replacement_budget = fill_empty_seats(selected_accounts, ranked_accounts, previous_active, max_validators, replacement_budget)
    if len(selected_accounts) >= max_validators and replacement_budget > 0:
        selected_accounts = replace_incumbents(selected_accounts, ranked_accounts, previous_active, deactivated, replacement_budget)
    if len(selected_accounts) == 0:
        assert require_selection == False, 'Rebalance would leave no active validators.'
        last_rebalance_epoch.set(selection_epoch)
        return {'mode': selection_mode, 'epoch': selection_epoch, 'previous_active': previous_active, 'selected': previous_active, 'ranked_candidates': ranked_accounts, 'activated': [], 'deactivated': [], 'retained': True}
    activated = []
    new_power = 0
    for account in known_accounts:
        if account in selected_accounts:
            if account not in previous_active:
                activated.append(account)
                start_active_stint(account)
                new_power += selected_validator_power(account)
            pending_registrations[account] = False
            if not pending_leave[account]:
                statuses[account] = STATUS_ACTIVE
            left_at[account] = None
            eligible_at_epoch[account] = selection_epoch
            reward_keys[account] = effective_reward_key(account)
            requested_power[account] = effective_requested_power(account)
            powers[account] = selected_validator_power(account)
        else:
            if statuses[account] == STATUS_ACTIVE:
                statuses[account] = STATUS_APPROVED
            if pending_registrations[account] == True:
                next_candidates.append(account)
            elif statuses[account] == STATUS_APPROVED:
                next_candidates.append(account)
            if account in previous_active or statuses[account] == STATUS_APPROVED:
                powers[account] = 0
    active_validators.set(selected_accounts)
    candidates.set(next_candidates)
    last_rebalance_epoch.set(selection_epoch)
    if new_power > 0:
        record_admitted_power(new_power)
    require_total_power_within_limit()
    return {'mode': selection_mode, 'epoch': selection_epoch, 'previous_active': previous_active, 'selected': selected_accounts, 'ranked_candidates': ranked_accounts, 'activated': activated, 'deactivated': deactivated, 'retained': False}

def validator_record(account: str):
    previous_rebalance_epoch = last_rebalance_epoch.get()
    selection_epoch = previous_rebalance_epoch or 0
    active = account in active_nodes_list()
    return importlib.import_module('validator_penalties').describe_validator(account=account, derived={'active': active, 'power': effective_active_power(account), 'requested_power': effective_requested_power(account), 'reward_key': effective_reward_key(account), 'commission_bps': effective_commission_bps(account), 'last_rebalance_epoch': previous_rebalance_epoch, 'selection_eligible_at_last_rebalance': can_be_selected(account, policy('selection_mode'), selection_epoch)})

def ceil_div(value: int, divisor: int):
    return (value + divisor - 1) // divisor

def total_member_weight_internal():
    total = 0
    for node in active_nodes_list():
        total += effective_active_power(node)
    return total

def require_total_power_within_limit():
    assert total_member_weight_internal() <= MAX_TOTAL_VOTING_POWER, 'Total validator power exceeds the consensus maximum.'

def is_last_active_validator(account: str):
    current_nodes = active_nodes_list()
    return len(current_nodes) == 1 and account in current_nodes

def require_not_last_active_validator(account: str):
    assert is_last_active_validator(account) == False, 'Cannot remove the last active validator.'

def required_yes_weight(total_weight: int):
    assert total_weight > 0, 'No voting weight.'
    return ceil_div(total_weight * PASS_THRESHOLD_NUMERATOR, PASS_THRESHOLD_DENOMINATOR)

def required_yes_votes(member_count: int):
    assert member_count > 0, 'No validators.'
    return ceil_div(member_count * PASS_THRESHOLD_NUMERATOR, PASS_THRESHOLD_DENOMINATOR)

def snapshot_vote_weights(proposal_id: int):
    total_weight = 0
    for node in active_nodes_list():
        weight = effective_active_power(node)
        vote_weights[proposal_id, node] = weight
        total_weight += weight
    return total_weight

def active_member_snapshot():
    snapshot = []
    for node in active_nodes_list():
        snapshot.append(node)
    return snapshot

def store_vote_record(proposal_id: int, voter: str, vote: str, weight: int):
    vote_records[proposal_id, voter] = vote
    current_vote = votes[proposal_id]
    ValidatorProposalVotedEvent({'proposal_id': proposal_id, 'voter': voter, 'vote': vote, 'weight': weight, 'yes_votes': current_vote['yes'], 'no_votes': current_vote['no'], 'yes_weight': current_vote['yes_weight'], 'no_weight': current_vote['no_weight']})

def update_profile_fields(account: str, reward_key: str=None, requested_validator_power: int=None, commission_bps_value: int=None, moniker: str=None, network_endpoint: str=None, metadata_uri: str=None):
    if reward_key is not None:
        reward_keys[account] = normalize_reward_key(account, reward_key)
    if requested_validator_power is not None:
        requested_power[account] = require_validator_power(requested_validator_power)
    if commission_bps_value is not None:
        assert commission_bps_value >= 0, 'Commission < 0'
        max_commission = config['max_commission_bps']
        if max_commission is None:
            max_commission = MAX_COMMISSION_BPS
        assert commission_bps_value <= max_commission, 'Commission too high.'
        commission_bps[account] = commission_bps_value
    if moniker is not None:
        monikers[account] = moniker
    if network_endpoint is not None:
        network_endpoints[account] = network_endpoint
    if metadata_uri is not None:
        metadata_uris[account] = metadata_uri

def start_active_stint(account: str):
    joined_at[account] = now
    missed_blocks[account] = 0

def activate_member(account: str, power: int):
    require_selection_capacity(account, all_validator_accounts())
    track_validator(account)
    current_nodes = active_nodes_list()
    if account not in current_nodes:
        current_nodes.append(account)
        active_validators.set(current_nodes)
    current_candidates = candidate_list()
    if account in current_candidates:
        candidates.set(without_item(current_candidates, account))
    pending_registrations[account] = False
    pending_leave[account] = False
    statuses[account] = STATUS_ACTIVE
    start_active_stint(account)
    left_at[account] = None
    eligible_at_epoch[account] = 0
    requested_power[account] = power
    powers[account] = power
    reward_keys[account] = effective_reward_key(account)
    require_total_power_within_limit()

def refund_validator_bond(account: str):
    held_balance = holdings[account]
    if held_balance > 0:
        currency.transfer(held_balance, effective_reward_key(account))
        holdings[account] = 0

def deactivate_member(account: str, status: str, refund_bond: bool):
    active_validators.set(without_item(active_nodes_list(), account))
    pending_leave[account] = False
    statuses[account] = status
    left_at[account] = now
    powers[account] = 0
    if refund_bond:
        refund_validator_bond(account)

def exit_validator(account: str, status: str, refund_bond: bool):
    require_no_pending_slash(account)
    if account in active_nodes_list():
        deactivate_member(account, status, refund_bond)
    else:
        pending_leave[account] = False
        statuses[account] = status
        left_at[account] = now
        powers[account] = 0
        if refund_bond:
            refund_validator_bond(account)
    pending_registrations[account] = False
    candidates.set(without_item(candidate_list(), account))
    importlib.import_module('validator_penalties').track_exit_time(account=account)
    sweep_validator_bonding_state(account, status)

def jail_validator(account: str, reason: str=None):
    assert is_known_validator(account), 'Unknown validator.'
    assert is_jailed(account) == False, 'Already jailed.'
    jailed[account] = True
    jail_reasons[account] = normalize_jail_reason(reason)
    last_jailed_at[account] = now
    pending_leave[account] = False
    powers[account] = 0
    if account in active_nodes_list():
        active_validators.set(without_item(active_nodes_list(), account))
        statuses[account] = STATUS_APPROVED
        left_at[account] = now
        ensure_candidate(account)
        return
    if statuses[account] == STATUS_LEAVING:
        statuses[account] = STATUS_APPROVED
        left_at[account] = now
        ensure_candidate(account)
        return
    if statuses[account] == STATUS_APPROVED or pending_registrations[account] == True:
        ensure_candidate(account)

def unjail_validator(account: str):
    require_no_pending_slash(account)
    assert is_jailed(account) == True, 'Not jailed.'
    jailed[account] = False
    jail_reasons[account] = None
    last_unjailed_at[account] = now
    if account in active_nodes_list():
        return
    if pending_registrations[account] == True or statuses[account] == STATUS_APPROVED:
        ensure_candidate(account)

def pay_slash(account: str, amount: decimal, destination: str):
    assert amount >= 0, 'Negative penalty.'
    total_slashed[account] += amount
    last_slashed_at[account] = now
    if amount > 0:
        currency.transfer(amount, destination)

def slash_live_stake(account: str, slash_bps: int, reason: str):
    rate = slash_bps / 10000
    self_slashed = self_bond[account] * rate
    slash_amount = total_bonded(account) * rate
    delegated_slashed = slash_amount - self_slashed
    self_bond[account] -= self_slashed
    total_delegated[account] -= delegated_slashed
    destination = policy('slash_destination')
    pay_slash(account, slash_amount, destination)
    return {'member': account, 'slash_bps': slash_bps, 'slash_amount': slash_amount, 'self_bond_slashed': self_slashed, 'delegated_slashed': delegated_slashed, 'pending_unbond_slashed': 0, 'destination': destination, 'reason': reason, 'slashed_at': now, 'remaining_self_bond': self_bond[account], 'remaining_total_delegated': total_delegated[account], 'remaining_total_bond': total_bonded(account)}

def pending_penalty_count(account: str):
    return penalty_counts[account] or 0

def require_no_pending_slash(account: str):
    assert pending_penalty_count(account) == 0, 'Validator penalty pending.'

def eligible_pending_unbond(account: str, infraction_height: int=None):
    if infraction_height is None:
        return False
    tail = pending_unbond_tails['validator', account]
    if tail is None:
        return False
    if pending_unbonds[tail]['created_block'] < infraction_height:
        return False
    return importlib.import_module('validator_penalties').get_unbond_summary(validator=account)['pending_unbond_total'] > 0

def has_slashable_stake(account: str, infraction_height: int=None):
    return total_bonded(account) > 0 or eligible_pending_unbond(account, infraction_height)

def penalty_reason(reason: str=None):
    reason = normalize_reason(reason)
    assert len(reason) <= 256, 'Penalty reason is too long.'
    return reason

def slash_validator(account: str, slash_bps: int, reason: str=None, infraction_height: int=None):
    assert has_validator_history(account), 'Unknown validator.'
    assert is_integer(slash_bps) and slash_bps > 0 and (slash_bps <= 10000), 'Bad slash bps.'
    assert has_slashable_stake(account, infraction_height), 'No slashable stake.'
    reason = penalty_reason(reason)
    if pending_penalty_count(account) > 0 or eligible_pending_unbond(account, infraction_height):
        coordinator = importlib.import_module('validator_penalties')
        return coordinator.enqueue(account=account, slash_bps=slash_bps, reason=reason, infraction_height=infraction_height)
    return slash_live_stake(account, slash_bps, reason)

def require_penalty_coordinator():
    assert ctx.caller == 'validator_penalties', 'Penalty coordinator only.'

@export
def apply_pending_slash_part(account: str, kind: str, amount: decimal, unbond_id: int=None):
    require_penalty_coordinator()
    assert amount >= 0, 'Negative penalty.'
    if kind == 'self_bond':
        assert self_bond[account] >= amount, 'Penalty exceeds stake.'
        self_bond[account] -= amount
    elif kind == 'delegation_pool':
        assert total_delegated[account] >= amount, 'Penalty exceeds stake.'
        total_delegated[account] -= amount
    else:
        assert kind == 'pending_unbond', 'Invalid penalty participant.'
        unbond = pending_unbonds[unbond_id]
        assert unbond['validator'] == account and unbond['claimed'] == False, 'Invalid penalty unbond.'
        assert unbond['amount'] >= amount, 'Penalty exceeds stake.'
        unbond['amount'] -= amount
        pending_unbonds[unbond_id] = unbond

@export
def finish_pending_slash(account: str, amount: decimal, destination: str):
    require_penalty_coordinator()
    pay_slash(account, amount, destination)

@export
def rebalance_after_penalties():
    require_penalty_coordinator()
    if policy('selection_mode') != 'manual':
        rebalance_validator_set(force=True, require_selection=False)

def apply_evidence_penalty_internal(account: str, infraction_type: str, evidence_id: str, evidence_height: int=None):
    assert evidence_id is not None, 'Missing evidence_id.'
    assert evidence_id != '', 'Missing evidence_id.'
    if processed_evidence[evidence_id] == True:
        return {'applied': False, 'duplicate': True, 'member': account, 'infraction_type': infraction_type, 'evidence_id': evidence_id}
    processed_evidence[evidence_id] = True
    last_evidence_ids[account] = evidence_id
    last_evidence_types[account] = infraction_type
    last_evidence_heights[account] = evidence_height
    last_evidence_at[account] = now
    slash_bps = evidence_slash_bps(infraction_type)
    should_jail = evidence_should_jail(infraction_type)
    slash_result = None
    jailed_now = False
    state_changed = False
    reason = infraction_type.lower()
    if slash_bps > 0 and has_slashable_stake(account, evidence_height):
        slash_result = slash_validator(account, slash_bps, reason, evidence_height)
        state_changed = True
    if should_jail and can_jail_member(account):
        jail_validator(account, reason)
        jailed_now = True
        state_changed = True
    if state_changed and policy('selection_mode') != 'manual':
        rebalance_validator_set(force=True, require_selection=False)
    return {'applied': state_changed, 'duplicate': False, 'member': account, 'infraction_type': infraction_type, 'evidence_id': evidence_id, 'evidence_height': evidence_height, 'slash_bps': slash_bps, 'jail': should_jail, 'jailed_now': jailed_now, 'slash_result': slash_result}

def validate_manual_override_policy(type_of_vote: str):
    selection_mode = policy('selection_mode')
    if selection_mode == 'manual':
        return
    if type_of_vote == 'add_member':
        assert selection_mode == 'hybrid', 'Hybrid only.'
        return
    if type_of_vote == 'remove_member' or type_of_vote == 'set_member_power' or type_of_vote == 'jail_member' or (type_of_vote == 'unjail_member'):
        assert policy('manual_override_enabled') == True, 'Overrides off.'

def validate_vote_argument(type_of_vote: str, arg: Any):
    if type_of_vote == 'add_member':
        validate_non_empty_string(arg, 'Member')
        validate_manual_override_policy(type_of_vote)
        if policy('selection_mode') == 'manual':
            assert pending_registrations[arg] == True or statuses[arg] == STATUS_APPROVED, 'Member must have pending registration.'
        else:
            assert pending_registrations[arg] == True, 'Member must have pending registration.'
        assert is_jailed(arg) == False, 'Jailed.'
        require_min_bonds(arg)
    if type_of_vote == 'remove_member':
        validate_non_empty_string(arg, 'Member')
        validate_manual_override_policy(type_of_vote)
        assert arg in active_nodes_list(), 'Active only.'
        require_not_last_active_validator(arg)
    if type_of_vote == 'jail_member':
        validate_object_argument(arg, ['member', 'reason'], ['member'])
        validate_manual_override_policy(type_of_vote)
        member = arg['member']
        validate_non_empty_string(member, 'Member')
        validate_optional_string(arg.get('reason'), 'Reason')
        assert arg.get('reason') != 'downtime', 'The downtime reason is reserved.'
        assert is_known_validator(member), 'Unknown validator.'
        assert is_jailed(member) == False, 'Already jailed.'
        require_not_last_active_validator(member)
    if type_of_vote == 'unjail_member':
        validate_non_empty_string(arg, 'Member')
        validate_manual_override_policy(type_of_vote)
        assert is_jailed(arg) == True, 'Not jailed.'
    if type_of_vote == 'slash_member':
        validate_object_argument(arg, ['member', 'slash_bps', 'reason', 'infraction_height'], ['member', 'slash_bps'])
        member = arg['member']
        slash_bps = arg['slash_bps']
        infraction_height = arg.get('infraction_height')
        validate_non_empty_string(member, 'Member')
        assert is_integer(slash_bps), 'Slash bps must be an integer.'
        validate_optional_string(arg.get('reason'), 'Reason')
        if infraction_height is not None:
            assert is_integer(infraction_height), 'Infraction height must be an integer.'
            assert infraction_height >= 0, 'Infraction height < 0'
        assert has_validator_history(member), 'Unknown validator.'
        assert slash_bps > 0, 'Slash bps <= 0'
        assert slash_bps <= 10000, 'Slash bps > 10000'
        penalty_reason(arg.get('reason'))
        assert has_slashable_stake(member, infraction_height), 'No slashable stake.'
    if type_of_vote == 'set_member_power':
        validate_object_argument(arg, ['member', 'power'], ['member', 'power'])
        validate_manual_override_policy(type_of_vote)
        member = arg['member']
        power = arg['power']
        validate_non_empty_string(member, 'Member')
        assert is_integer(power), 'Power must be an integer.'
        assert member in active_nodes_list(), 'Active only.'
        assert power > 0, 'Power <= 0'
        require_validator_power(power)
    if type_of_vote == 'update_policy':
        validate_policy_update(arg)
    if type_of_vote == 'change_registration_fee':
        assert is_number(arg), 'Registration fee must be numeric.'
        assert arg > 0, 'Registration fee <= 0'
    if type_of_vote == 'reward_change':
        assert isinstance(arg, list), 'Reward split must be a list.'
        assert len(arg) == 4, 'Reward split must have 4 values.'
        for value in arg:
            assert is_number(value), 'Reward split values must be numeric.'
            assert value >= 0, 'Reward split values must be non-negative.'
        assert sum(arg) == 1, 'Reward split must sum to 1.'
    if type_of_vote == 'dao_payout':
        validate_object_argument(arg, ['contract_name', 'amount', 'to'], ['contract_name', 'amount', 'to'])
        validate_non_empty_string(arg['contract_name'], 'Contract name')
        assert importlib.exists(arg['contract_name']), 'DAO contract does not exist.'
        assert is_number(arg['amount']), 'DAO amount must be numeric.'
        assert arg['amount'] > 0, 'DAO amount must be positive.'
        validate_non_empty_string(arg['to'], 'DAO recipient')
    if type_of_vote == 'chi_cost_change':
        assert is_integer(arg), 'Chi cost must be an integer.'
        assert arg > 0, 'Chi cost must be positive.'
        assert arg <= chi_cost.max_value(), 'Chi cost exceeds the largest rate the node can price with.'
    if type_of_vote == 'change_types':
        assert isinstance(arg, list), 'Vote types must be a list.'
        assert len(arg) > 0, 'Vote types must not be empty.'
        seen_types = []
        for vote_type in arg:
            validate_non_empty_string(vote_type, 'Vote type')
            assert vote_type not in seen_types, 'Duplicate vote type.'
            seen_types.append(vote_type)
        for recovery_vote_type in recovery_vote_types():
            assert recovery_vote_type in seen_types, 'Missing recovery vote type: ' + recovery_vote_type
    if type_of_vote == 'topic_vote':
        validate_object_argument(arg, ['topic'], ['topic'])
        validate_non_empty_string(arg['topic'], 'Topic')

def validate_policy_update(arg: Any):
    validate_object_argument(arg, POLICY_KEYS, [])
    assert len(arg) > 0, 'Policy update must not be empty.'
    for key in POLICY_KEYS:
        if arg.get(key) is not None:
            validate_policy_value(key, arg[key])

def apply_policy_update(arg: Any):
    for key in POLICY_KEYS:
        if arg.get(key) is not None:
            config[key] = arg[key]

@export
def propose_vote(type_of_vote: str, arg: Any):
    assert ctx.caller in active_nodes_list(), 'Validators only.'
    assert type_of_vote in types.get(), 'Invalid type.'
    validate_vote_argument(type_of_vote, arg)
    proposal_id = total_votes.get() + 1
    total_votes.set(proposal_id)
    total_weight_snapshot = snapshot_vote_weights(proposal_id)
    proposer_weight = vote_weights[proposal_id, ctx.caller]
    member_snapshot = active_member_snapshot()
    votes[proposal_id] = {'yes': 1, 'no': 0, 'yes_weight': proposer_weight, 'no_weight': 0, 'type': type_of_vote, 'arg': arg, 'voters': [ctx.caller], 'finalized': False, 'status': STATUS_PENDING, 'created_at': now, 'expiry': now + datetime.timedelta(days=PROPOSAL_EXPIRY_DAYS), 'member_snapshot': member_snapshot, 'member_count_snapshot': len(member_snapshot), 'total_weight_snapshot': total_weight_snapshot, 'required_yes_votes': required_yes_votes(len(member_snapshot)), 'required_yes_weight': required_yes_weight(total_weight_snapshot)}
    ValidatorProposalSubmittedEvent({'proposal_id': proposal_id, 'type_of_vote': type_of_vote, 'proposer': ctx.caller, 'status': STATUS_PENDING})
    if type_of_vote == 'add_member':
        current_vote = votes[proposal_id]
        current_vote['member_power'] = effective_requested_power(arg)
        votes[proposal_id] = current_vote
    store_vote_record(proposal_id, ctx.caller, 'yes', proposer_weight)
    decide_finalize(proposal_id)
    return votes[proposal_id]

@export
def vote(proposal_id: int, vote: str):
    assert votes[proposal_id], 'Invalid proposal.'
    assert votes[proposal_id]['finalized'] == False, 'Proposal already finalized.'
    assert now < votes[proposal_id]['expiry'], 'Proposal expired.'
    assert vote in ['yes', 'no'], 'Invalid vote.'
    assert ctx.caller not in votes[proposal_id]['voters'], 'Already voted.'
    voter_weight = vote_weights[proposal_id, ctx.caller]
    assert voter_weight > 0, 'Not eligible to vote on this proposal.'
    current_vote = votes[proposal_id]
    current_vote[vote] += 1
    if vote == 'yes':
        current_vote['yes_weight'] += voter_weight
    else:
        current_vote['no_weight'] += voter_weight
    current_vote['voters'].append(ctx.caller)
    votes[proposal_id] = current_vote
    store_vote_record(proposal_id, ctx.caller, vote, voter_weight)
    decide_finalize(proposal_id)
    return votes[proposal_id]

@export
def expire_vote(proposal_id: int):
    assert votes[proposal_id], 'Invalid proposal.'
    assert votes[proposal_id]['finalized'] == False, 'Proposal already finalized.'
    assert now >= votes[proposal_id]['expiry'], 'Proposal has not expired.'
    current_vote = votes[proposal_id]
    current_vote['finalized'] = True
    current_vote['status'] = STATUS_EXPIRED
    votes[proposal_id] = current_vote
    ValidatorProposalExpiredEvent({'proposal_id': proposal_id, 'type_of_vote': current_vote['type'], 'expirer': ctx.caller, 'status': STATUS_EXPIRED})
    return current_vote

def decide_finalize(proposal_id: int):
    current_vote = votes[proposal_id]
    if current_vote['yes_weight'] >= current_vote['required_yes_weight']:
        finalize_vote(proposal_id)
        return
    remaining_weight = current_vote['total_weight_snapshot'] - current_vote['yes_weight'] - current_vote['no_weight']
    if current_vote['yes_weight'] + remaining_weight < current_vote['required_yes_weight']:
        reject_vote(proposal_id)

def reject_vote(proposal_id: int):
    current_vote = votes[proposal_id]
    current_vote['finalized'] = True
    current_vote['status'] = STATUS_REJECTED
    votes[proposal_id] = current_vote
    ValidatorProposalRejectedEvent({'proposal_id': proposal_id, 'type_of_vote': current_vote['type'], 'rejector': ctx.caller, 'status': STATUS_REJECTED})

def can_add_member(member: str):
    if is_jailed(member):
        return False
    if meets_min_bonds(member) == False:
        return False
    if pending_registrations[member] == True:
        return True
    return policy('selection_mode') == 'manual' and statuses[member] == STATUS_APPROVED

def can_jail_member(member: str):
    return is_known_validator(member) and is_jailed(member) == False and (is_last_active_validator(member) == False)

def can_remove_member(member: str):
    return member in active_nodes_list() and is_last_active_validator(member) == False

def proposal_still_applies(current_vote: dict):
    vote_type = current_vote['type']
    if vote_type == 'add_member':
        return can_add_member(current_vote['arg'])
    if vote_type == 'remove_member':
        return can_remove_member(current_vote['arg'])
    if vote_type == 'jail_member':
        return can_jail_member(current_vote['arg']['member'])
    return True

def finalize_vote(proposal_id: int):
    current_vote = votes[proposal_id]
    if proposal_still_applies(current_vote) == False:
        reject_vote(proposal_id)
        return votes[proposal_id]
    if current_vote['type'] == 'add_member':
        member = current_vote['arg']
        member_power = current_vote['member_power']
        if policy('selection_mode') == 'manual':
            activate_member(member, member_power)
        else:
            approve_candidate(member, member_power)
            rebalance_validator_set(force=True)
    elif current_vote['type'] == 'remove_member':
        exit_validator(current_vote['arg'], STATUS_REMOVED, True)
        if policy('selection_mode') != 'manual':
            rebalance_validator_set(force=True)
    elif current_vote['type'] == 'jail_member':
        jail_validator(current_vote['arg']['member'], current_vote['arg'].get('reason'))
        if policy('selection_mode') != 'manual':
            rebalance_validator_set(force=True)
    elif current_vote['type'] == 'unjail_member':
        unjail_validator(current_vote['arg'])
        if policy('selection_mode') != 'manual':
            rebalance_validator_set(force=True)
    elif current_vote['type'] == 'slash_member':
        current_vote['result'] = slash_validator(current_vote['arg']['member'], current_vote['arg']['slash_bps'], current_vote['arg'].get('reason'), current_vote['arg'].get('infraction_height'))
        if policy('selection_mode') != 'manual':
            rebalance_validator_set(force=True)
    elif current_vote['type'] == 'set_member_power':
        member = current_vote['arg']['member']
        power = current_vote['arg']['power']
        requested_power[member] = power
        if policy('selection_mode') == 'manual':
            powers[member] = power
            require_total_power_within_limit()
        elif policy('power_mode') == 'requested':
            rebalance_validator_set(force=True)
    elif current_vote['type'] == 'update_policy':
        apply_policy_update(current_vote['arg'])
        if policy('selection_mode') != 'manual':
            rebalance_validator_set(force=True)
    elif current_vote['type'] == 'reward_change':
        rewards.set_value(new_value=current_vote['arg'])
    elif current_vote['type'] == 'dao_payout':
        dao.transfer_from_dao(args=current_vote['arg'])
    elif current_vote['type'] == 'chi_cost_change':
        chi_cost.set_value(new_value=current_vote['arg'])
    elif current_vote['type'] == 'change_registration_fee':
        registration_fee.set(current_vote['arg'])
    elif current_vote['type'] == 'change_types':
        types.set(current_vote['arg'])
    current_vote['finalized'] = True
    current_vote['status'] = STATUS_APPROVED
    votes[proposal_id] = current_vote
    ValidatorProposalApprovedEvent({'proposal_id': proposal_id, 'type_of_vote': current_vote['type'], 'approver': ctx.caller, 'status': STATUS_APPROVED})
    return current_vote
